profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary: I am a programmer located in Kansas City MO, with 3 years of experience in creating innovative and efficient web and software solutions. I work as a full stack developer, but am passionate about front-end technologies. Please connect with me if you want to share tech news, project/job opportunities, or cool coding tools.
